Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.surveyaction.controls

Enum Class ParquetFileMetric

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ParquetFileMetric>
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.surveyaction.controls.ParquetFileMetric
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ParquetFileMetric>, Constable, SurveyMetric
public enum ParquetFileMetric extends Enum<ParquetFileMetric> implements SurveyMetric
ParquetFileMetric describes the measurements that the Parquet survey action service takes from the footer of an Apache Parquet file.
